data.title: DSI refers second Stark case to attorney-general
data.description: <p>The Department of Special Investigation (DSI) has referred a second money-laundering case involving Stark Corporation (STARK) to the Office of the Attorney-General (OAG), whose ruling will determine jurisdiction over the transfer of 743 million baht to Singapore.</p>

data.title: Court set to rule on ballot secrecy row
data.description: <p>The Constitutional Court will rule on Sept 28 on whether barcodes and QR codes printed on ballot papers used in the Feb 8 general election breached constitutional protections for secret voting.</p>

data.title: Senate probe leak sparks legal action
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul on Wednesday backed legal action against those responsible for leaking documents from an investigation into alleged collusion in the 2024 Senate election.</p>

data.title: Vegetables pass formalin test after Chinese scare
data.description: <p>The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has found no formalin contamination in 42 vegetable samples tested in the wake of reports of formalin being used on Chinese cabbage.</p>

data.title: Thais 'lag in using AI for work'
data.description: <p>Thailand has the world's highest usage of Google's Gemini Nano Banana for image generation, indicating a high level of creativity among Thai users. However, the country still lags behind its neighbours in using AI to boost productivity and economic value.</p>

data.title: Task force denies helicopter shots
data.description: <p>The Narathiwat Task Force has rejected reports that troops fired an M16 rifle from a helicopter at a group of youths in Chanae district, saying personnel carried no weapons during the surveillance mission.</p>

data.title: B57bn sought for southern projects
data.description: <p>Nearly 200 projects worth more than 57 billion baht have been proposed by five southern border provinces ahead of next week's mobile cabinet meeting in Hat Yai district of Songkhla.</p>

data.title: PM urges focus on upskilling
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has called for closer Asean cooperation to upgrade workers' skills in response to rapid advances in artificial intelligence, the green economy and demographic change, while promoting an Asean Digital Skills Passport to facilitate cross-border employment.</p>

data.title: Cyber cops seize guns in online crackdown
data.description: <p>Cyber police have arrested 186 people and seized 228 firearms, 1,294 rounds of ammunition and an improvised explosive device in a nationwide crackdown on illegal online gun trading.</p>

data.title: Energy crisis 'drives loan'
data.description: <p>Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas has defended the government's 400-billion-baht emergency loan decree as essential to economic security as the energy crisis pushes the current-account deficit towards 600 billion baht.</p>

data.title: Fake school shooting threat a cover for a late delivery
data.description: RATCHABURI - Officials closed a school serving 3,000 students on Wednesday after receiving a shooting threat, only to find out later that a sports day jersey supplier had used it to postpone a delivery.

data.title: Abhisit says borrowing B400 billion won’t spur growth
data.description: Democrat Party leader Abhisit Vejjajiva has outlined four reasons for rejecting an emergency decree authorising the government to borrow 400 billion baht, warning that its passage would do little to change Thailand’s economic growth prospects while leaving people exposed to an ongoing energy crisis.

data.title: Suvarnabhumi road maintenance to disrupt traffic
data.description: Suvarnabhumi airport in Bangkok has advised passengers to plan their journeys in advance and allow extra travel time as a maintenance project will block some traffic lanes to and from the passenger terminal from next Monday to April 7 of next year.

data.title: 32 villagers fined for stealing shrimp from crashed truck
data.description: Thirty-two residents of Lampang have been fined 10,000 baht each for stealing almost 1.2 tonnes of shrimp worth around 300,000 baht from a truck after it crashed in Thoen district in the northern province in March.

data.title: Five fined for somersault stunt on Chon Buri road
data.description: CHON BURI — Five women have been fined for safety violations after a video showing them dancing, using hula hoops and performing somersaults in the middle of Sukhumvit Road in Sattahip went viral.

data.title: Alcohol explosion in science class causes injuries at Yala school
data.description: A science experiment went wrong at a school in Yala province on Wednesday, after alcohol exploded in a classroom, injuring teachers and students.

data.title: Chon Buri plant faces illegal waste disposal charges
data.description: Industry Minister Varawut Silpa-archa has ordered legal action against a Chinese-owned factory for dumping 700 tonnes of industrial waste outside its factory in Chon Buri province.

data.title: FDA approvals boost Thailand's vaccine self-reliance
data.description: <p>Thailand has taken steps to strengthen its vaccine supply, with a nine-strain HPV vaccine and a botulinum antitoxin registered by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA).</p>

data.title: US aircraft carrier’s visit ‘for relaxation only’
data.description: The upcoming visit of the USS Abraham Lincoln carrier strike group to eastern Thailand next week is purely for crew relaxation and no joint military operations are planned, according to the Ministry of Defence.

data.title: Road traffic at Suvarnabhumi may be disrupted Aug 31-April 7
data.description: Suvarnabhumi airport in Bangkok has advised passengers to plan their journeys in advance and allow extra travel time as a maintenance project will block some traffic lanes to and from the passenger terminal from next Monday to April 7 of next year.

data.title: Citizenship bust targets 5,000 ‘fake Thais’ in Chiang Mai
data.description: CHIANG MAI — Local administrators and migrants were among 20 suspects arrested in this northern province as part of a fake citizenship bust believed to involve about 5,000 “fake Thais” made in just one district.

data.title: Coordinated attacks: Thailand's southern insurgency flares
data.description: A surge in attacks across Thailand's South has put a spotlight on the low-level insurgency by Muslim separatists that has killed thousands of people in the last two decades.

data.title: Citizenship bust targets 5,000 ‘fake Thais’ in Chiang Mai's district

data.title: Teen arrested for allegedly making and selling guns online
data.description: A 16-year-old boy was arrested during a raid on a condominium in Bangkok's Laksi district after police discovered he was allegedly modifying guns and selling them through a social media group with more than 300 members.

data.title: Police bust Thai network illegally transporting Chinese to Malaysia
data.description: Immigration police arrested two key figures for allegedly running a network illegally transporting Chinese nationals from the Cambodian border through Thailand to Malaysia with a brokerage fee of over 60,000 per person.

data.title: Executive overhaul in the pipeline
data.description: <p>The cabinet has given the nod to a major reshuffle of 20 senior officials under the Interior Ministry, in what is seen as the biggest personnel overhaul since the Anutin Charnvirakul administration returned to office for its second term.</p>

data.title: Early retirement guidelines for civil servants take shape
data.description: <p>Guidelines for an early retirement scheme for civil servants are expected to be finalised tomorrow before they are submitted to the cabinet, as the government pushes ahead with its broader reform of the public-sector workforce.</p>

data.title: 2 ex-DLA chiefs in crosshairs
data.description: <p>The National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) has confirmed that two former director-generals of the Department of Local Administration (DLA) are implicated in alleged cheating in the 2025 local government recruitment examination.</p>

data.title: Drug-laced vape liquid raises health fears
data.description: <p>The Department of Medical Sciences has warned e-cigarette users of potentially fatal risks after detecting methamphetamine and etomidate in vape liquid for the first time.</p>

data.title: Cash mules held after drug probe
data.description: <p>Three people have been arrested after a Bangkok police investigation into online drug activity uncovered a scam network allegedly using cash mules to move money and fund drug purchases.</p>

data.title: Tax incentives to boost U-Tapao project in EEC
data.description: <p>The government will introduce tax incentives and other measures to help speed up the long-delayed U-Tapao Airport and Eastern Aerotropolis development project, with the private sector expected to invest about 1.3 trillion baht over the project's life.</p>

data.title: PM orders probe into copter shooting claim
data.description: <p>Prime Minister and Interior Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has ordered an investigation into allegations that security personnel fired on civilians from a helicopter during recent unrest in the southernmost provinces, despite a firm denial from the Fourth Army Region commander.</p>
